event_info.event_description: Analyze for disclosures on global pandemic risks. Look for corporate language discussing widespread impacts like supply chain disruptions, labor shortages, remote work transitions, and fundamental shifts in consumer demand.

holistic_analysis: MAS’s 2023 filing treats COVID-19 as an active, continuing threat that has already disrupted operations and may further erode financial performance.  The company discloses concrete operational impacts—facility shutdowns, supply-chain delays, cost inflation, logistics constraints and labor shortages—while also warning that future waves could materially harm results and intensify other risk factors.  These statements are recent (within three years of the pandemic’s declaration) and mostly describe realised or still-unfolding effects, which pushes the risk level toward the higher end of the 0-10 scale.  However, the narrative remains largely qualitative; no dollar figures or probability estimates are supplied, and some language is hedged (“may,” “could”).  Applying the Time Decay Principle (recent event) and discounting for the absence of quantification, the strongest sentences merit scores near 9, while generic list-style references receive only minimal points.
